plan_item: 77.44.7.A — responsive typography Inspector lifecycle and inheritance across PARTIAL types
finding: The prior cross-type test verified the 14 typography fields on desktop only; tablet/mobile inheritance, independent overrides, Save/Publish separation, and reset behavior were not covered as one end-to-end matrix.
change: Extended tests/browser/editor-inspector-typography-partial-types.test.js to run all 14 Registry fields on desktop, tablet, and mobile for each of the 44 editable PARTIAL element types. No runtime source or public asset changed.
coverage: 44 PARTIAL types × 14 typography fields on three breakpoints; typed Inspector controls and responsive.set key routing; Canvas CSS; draft Save without publication; reload restores all device values; separate Publish updates the chosen device only; mobile inherits tablet before a mobile override; tablet and desktop remain isolated; resetting mobile fontSize removes only that override, inherits tablet fontSize, preserves other mobile values, and recomputes mobile lineHeight from the inherited size.

browser.result: PASS, 1/1 full real Chromium lifecycle; 766.686 seconds.
corrected_fixture_attempts: The first expanded run observed Chromium's text-shadow alpha serialization as 0.5, not 0.502; corrected the expected computed CSS to the browser's actual value.

The next run observed that resetting mobile fontSize to inherit tablet fontSize leaves the mobile lineHeight override active, so Chromium correctly computes 52px (26px × 2). The reset assertion now derives that computed value from the inherited font size and mobile lineHeight. The final full run passed.
